newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not well tested on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Two loads Select and Choice 2-3 1275 lbs 105.00. Dressed Basis Heifers - No confirmed sales.
Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Demand and seller interest light. Weekly volume 84,300.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Heifers - No confirmed sales. Confirmed - 100 Last Week - 100 Last Year - 200
Wk To Date - None. Sm Pd Lst Wk - None. Sm Pd Lst Yr - None.
